videos.title: Resurgence
videos.overview: Waseem Khan survives a deadly assassination attempt and vows revenge on Vijay Singh. As Vijay resurfaces and strikes back, Bilal's hunt for him ends in disaster. Meanwhile, ACP Himanshu Patnaik returns to Uttar Pradesh to eliminate Vijay, setting the stage for a new and bloodier war in Poorvanchal.

videos.title: Setback
videos.overview: A flashback reveals how Saraswati Devi brought Waseem Khan back to Uttar Pradesh to counter Virendra Pratap Singh's growing influence. As a fierce political battle erupts over power, money and telecom contracts, the truth behind Roli Singh's death emerges. Her loss becomes the driving force behind Vijay Singh's ruthless return and quest for vengeance.

videos.title: License To kill
videos.overview: As Saraswati Devi and Waseem Khan intensify their assault on Virendra Pratap, Vijay Singh begins executing his own deadly plan. Using Gagan Srivastava as an insider inside Waseem's jail network, Vijay tracks his movements and launches a daring ambush at a restaurant. A fierce gun battle erupts, leaving Waseem critically wounded and his empire shaken.

videos.title: The Dark Horse
videos.overview: Bilal's death deepens tensions as Waseem Khan demands the Deputy CM post. Himanshu closes in on Virendra Pratap with a crucial witness, but Vijay Singh executes a masterstroke that destroys the case. Political equations shift, secret alliances emerge, and Saraswati Devi faces blackmail. The episode ends with a brutal attack on Chunnu, sending a chilling message to Vijay Singh.

videos.title: The Alliance
videos.overview: Chunnu's death hardens Vijay Singh's resolve as he vows to continue the war at any cost. Saraswati Devi outmaneuvers Waseem and appoints him Deputy CM, while STF closes in on Vijay through a trap. Waseem's assassination attempt fails, Vijay narrowly escapes an STF encounter, and in a shocking climax, he rescues Sanki and eliminates Mirza, gaining a powerful new ally.

videos.title: The Mole
videos.overview: Vijay Singh begins a calculated counterattack against his enemies, turning former rivals into allies and quietly expanding his influence across borders. A manipulated STF investigation drags Virendra Pratap into the Mirza Baig murder case, while Waseem Khan's political ambitions suffer a major setback after his son is caught in a massive narcotics bust.

videos.title: Holy War
videos.overview: Tahir's arrest triggers a political earthquake, weakening Waseem Khan and Saraswati Devi's government. Virendra Pratap seizes the opportunity, topples the regime through a no-confidence vote, and rises to power. Vijay emerges as a political force, while STF is dissolved and a ruthless new police crackdown begins, reshaping the future of Poorvanchal.

videos.title: Check-Mate
videos.overview: With enemies closing in from all sides, Vijay Singh returns for one final reckoning. His merciless confrontation with Waseem Khan ends an era of gang warfare, while a calculated political move from jail transforms him into the true kingmaker of the state. Revenge is achieved, but the game is far from over.
